description: Plays an internet radio stream, Icecast or plain HTTP, into a patch through a level control

params.text: Sets the output level, silent at the bottom and +12dB at the top, the gain following the square of the knob position as the VCV AUDIO module's does

inputs.text: Scales the level set by the knob: 0V silences the output and 10V leaves the knob's level alone, with anything outside that range clamped to it

outputs.text: The left channel of the stream, at line level after the level control
The right channel of the stream, at line level after the level control

notes: Click the station picture to open the picker and choose a station, or step through the whole list with the arrows; the choice is saved with the patch and reconnects when it is loaded
The lamp lights only while audio is really decoding, not merely because the server answered. When a connection fails, the reason is printed where the artwork goes
To add a station of your own, right-click, paste a stream or playlist address into the field under the stream URL label, and press Enter
A pasted address is checked in the background: the module confirms audio really flows, fetches a name and icon from radio-browser, and saves it. An unrecognised stream plays, then you name it
MP3, AAC and HLS streams play on every platform
The bundled stations are ordinary Rack presets, so they also appear under the Preset menu
menu: Play — connects to the current station and starts it; the same item reads Stop while a stream is playing
MIDI play: toggle on trigger (notes/pads) — when on, a mapped MIDI control flips play on each rising edge, rather than its value being read as the play state

inputs.0:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the knob's level, unscaled; a negative voltage does nothing here.
